Lilith.note: SE_MEAN_APOG is Moshier/ELP mean apogee with DE431-derived corrections (incl. periodic terms); it differs from the secular Meeus/IERS mean apogee by a documented ~4-7 arcmin, so the tolerance is 0.12 deg (model definition, not numerical error). SE_MEAN_APOG matches the prior Tommy kitchen-sink Lilith.
